# Configuration reference

`createTessera(config, options)` validates `config` against the schema below. A mistake fails fast with a readable message that names the path, for example `features.kanban.columns: expected array`.

```ts
import { createTessera } from '@tessera/core';

const tessera = createTessera(
  {
    appId: 'my-app',
    features: { chat: { enabled: true } },
  },
  { plugins: { chat: () => import('@tessera/chat') }, adapters },
);
```

## Instance options

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `appId` | `string` | yes | — | Namespace for storage keys and room names. Lower-case letters, digits and dashes, up to 40 characters. |
| `auth` | `object` | no | — | Who the current user is. Default `guest`: a random identity remembered in localStorage. |
| `auth.type` | `"static" \| "guest" \| "custom"` | yes | — |  |
| `auth.user` | `object` | yes when `type` is `"static"` | — | The signed-in user. |
| `auth.user.id` | `string` | yes when `type` is `"static"` | — | Stable user id. |
| `auth.user.name` | `string` | yes when `type` is `"static"` | — | Display name. |
| `auth.user.avatarUrl` | `string` | no when `type` is `"static"` | — | Image URL. Initials are shown when missing. |
| `auth.user.color` | `string` | no when `type` is `"static"` | — | CSS colour. Derived from the id when missing. |
| `auth.user.roles` | `string[]` | no when `type` is `"static"` | — | Role names such as `moderator`. |
| `auth.token` | `string` | no when `type` is `"static"` | — | Bearer token sent to the server and REST storage. |
| `auth.name` | `string` | no when `type` is `"guest"` | — | Display name. Random when omitted. |
| `auth.provider` | `function / object` | yes when `type` is `"custom"` | — | An AuthProvider implementation. |
| `transport` | `object` | no | — | How tabs and servers talk to each other. Default `none`. |
| `transport.type` | `"none" \| "local" \| "websocket" \| "custom"` | yes | — |  |
| `transport.channel` | `string` | no when `type` is `"local"` | — | BroadcastChannel name suffix; tabs on the same channel see each other. |
| `transport.url` | `string` | yes when `type` is `"websocket"` | — | WebSocket endpoint of tessera-server, e.g. `wss://example.com/v1/ws`. |
| `transport.reconnect` | `object` | no when `type` is `"websocket"` | — | Backoff tuning. Every field is optional. |
| `transport.reconnect.initialDelayMs` | `number` | no when `type` is `"websocket"` | — | First reconnect delay. Default 500. |
| `transport.reconnect.maxDelayMs` | `number` | no when `type` is `"websocket"` | — | Upper bound for the delay. Default 30000. |
| `transport.reconnect.factor` | `number` | no when `type` is `"websocket"` | — | Delay multiplier per failed attempt. Default 2. |
| `transport.reconnect.jitter` | `number` | no when `type` is `"websocket"` | — | Random spread as a fraction of the delay. Default 0.3. |
| `transport.reconnect.maxQueue` | `integer` | no when `type` is `"websocket"` | — | Outbound messages kept while offline. Default 200. |
| `transport.create` | `function / object` | yes when `type` is `"custom"` | — | Factory `(ctx) => Transport`. |
| `storage` | `object` | no | — | Where documents live. Default `memory`. |
| `storage.type` | `"memory" \| "local" \| "indexeddb" \| "rest" \| "custom"` | yes | — |  |
| `storage.dbName` | `string` | no when `type` is `"indexeddb"` | — | Database name. Defaults to `tessera-<appId>`. |
| `storage.baseUrl` | `string` | yes when `type` is `"rest"` | — | Base URL of a server implementing `/v1/docs`. |
| `storage.adapter` | `function / object` | yes when `type` is `"custom"` | — | A StorageAdapter implementation. |
| `uploads` | `object` | no | — | How files are stored. Default `dataurl`: small files are inlined and no server is needed. |
| `uploads.type` | `"dataurl" \| "rest" \| "custom"` | yes | — |  |
| `uploads.maxBytes` | `integer` | no when `type` is `"dataurl"` or `"rest"` | — | Size limit per file. Default 1000000. |
| `uploads.baseUrl` | `string` | yes when `type` is `"rest"` | — | Base URL of a server implementing `/v1/uploads`. |
| `uploads.adapter` | `function / object` | yes when `type` is `"custom"` | — | An UploadAdapter implementation. |
| `theme` | `object` | no | — |  |
| `theme.mode` | `"light" \| "dark" \| "auto"` | no | — | `light`, `dark` or `auto` (follow the OS). Default `auto`. |
| `theme.tokens` | `Record<string, string>` | no | — | CSS custom property overrides, e.g. `{ "--tessera-color-primary": "#0a7" }`. |
| `locale` | `string` | no | — | BCP 47 tag such as `en` or `de-CH`. Defaults to the browser language, then `en`. |
| `messages` | `Record<string, Record<string, string>>` | no | — | Message overrides as locale → key → template. These win over every plugin catalog. |
| `features` | `Record<string, Record<string, function / object>>` | yes | — | Feature id → options. Each plugin validates its own options when it is set up. |
| `features.<key>.enabled` | `boolean` | yes | — | Turn the feature on. A disabled feature never loads its code. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | no | — | Log debug output through the instance logger. |

Options that only apply to some variants say so in the *Required* column: choose the variant with the `type` field, for example `transport.type`.

## Editor autocomplete

A JSON Schema is published next to these docs. Point your JSON files at it:

```json
{ "$schema": "./tessera-config.schema.json", "appId": "my-app", "features": {} }
```

## Feature options

`features.<id>` is validated by the plugin that owns it when the feature is set up, and a failure is reported as `features.<id>.<option>: …`. Each kit documents its own options in its package README. Every plugin accepts `{ "enabled": true }` on its own: all other options have defaults.
